label: early original-phase steps (t=2-5) shortly after d/f/c/u/a/v
explanation: Fires almost only in the original (input) phase (99.8% of mass), at absolute positions t=2..5 (peak t=3-4), with no activity at t=0, the delimiter, or the copy phase. Inside that window it depends on which tokens came in the previous one or two steps: d gives by far the strongest boost (prev_tok=d active 28%, and the top activations are almost all right after a d, often d d or d c), followed by f, c, u, a, v. The current input also matters somewhat (d, c, l, w, v are favored) and it fires more on first occurrences of a token. Activation looks like a graded sum of recent-token contributions plus a position term, so a boolean predicate only gets part of it: the window plus prev/prev2 in {d,f,c,u,a,v} captures about 86% of mass but has low precision (~0.39), since many steps in the window with those tokens stay below threshold.
